note: Hand-curated, sourced entries. Special election for the seat JD Vance vacated.

OH-senate.statusNote: Special election: former Sen. Sherrod Brown (D) faces appointed Sen. Jon Husted (R) for the seat JD Vance vacated.

OH-governor.statusNote: Open seat (Gov. DeWine term-limited): Vivek Ramaswamy (R) faces Dr. Amy Acton (D).

candidates.name: Sherrod Brown
candidates.background: U.S. Senator 1993–2025 (House then Senate); lost his seat in 2024, now running in the 2026 special election. Known as one of the Senate's most labor-focused members.

cost.label: Career centered on working-class economics: opposed NAFTA/CAFTA, paid-sick-days bills, Stop Predatory Investing Act (Wikipedia)

health.label: Voted for the ACA; backed Medicare buy-in at 55+; earlier co-sponsored Medicare for All (Wikipedia)

housing.label: Co-sponsored YIGBY housing act and Stop Predatory Investing Act limiting corporate home-buying (Wikipedia)

taxes.label: Fought the 2017 tax law as favoring the wealthy and corporations (Wikipedia)

climate.label: Pushed EPA to regulate PFAS 'forever chemicals' (Wikipedia)

candidates.name: Jon Husted
candidates.background: Appointed U.S. Senator (Jan 2025) after JD Vance became Vice President; previously Ohio Lt. Governor and Secretary of State. Running to keep the seat in the special election.

taxes.label: Deregulation record: InnovateOhio, office budget cuts, lower business fees (Wikipedia)

climate.label: Sponsored 2025 repeal of appliance energy-efficiency standards as regulatory burden (Wikipedia)

education.label: Backed charter schools and expanded access to private/religious education (Wikipedia)

democracy.label: 'Easy to vote and hard to cheat': voter-roll purges (upheld 5–4 in Husted v. Randolph Institute), uniform early-voting limits (Wikipedia)

candidates.name: Vivek Ramaswamy
candidates.background: Biotech entrepreneur, author, and 2024 presidential candidate; briefly co-led DOGE. Endorsed by the Ohio Republican Party for the open governor seat.

immigration.label: Advocates ending birthright citizenship; merit-based H-1B reform (Wikipedia)

climate.label: 'Burn coal,' frack without 'environmental agendas'; opposes EV subsidies (Wikipedia)

education.label: Pledged to abolish the U.S. Education Department; opposes CRT in schools (Wikipedia)

safety.label: Mixed: military action against cartels, but supports federal marijuana legalization (Wikipedia)

democracy.label: Proposed raising the voting age to 25 absent service or a civics test (2023 campaign) (Wikipedia)

candidates.name: Amy Acton
candidates.background: Physician and former Ohio Department of Health director — the state's trusted voice in the early COVID-19 response.

health.label: Campaign centers healthcare costs: Medicaid, caregiver tax credits, marketplace affordability (Wikipedia)

candidates.now: Former Director, Ohio Department of Health
